newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ascom forms payphone venture in China.
newsitem.headline: Ascom forms payphone venture in China.

text.p: Swiss telecommunications group Ascom Holding AG said it had completed talks on forming a joint venture with a Chinese partner to produce Integrated Circuit card payphones.
The agreement was reached with Guangzhou Telecommunications Factory (GTEF), which is under the authority of the Chinese Post and Telecommunications Ministry in Beijing, Ascom said in a statement.
Ascom will hold 51 percent of the new company and have management responsibility, while GTEF will hold 49 percent.
Initially, annual production will run at 20,000 payphones a year. Pending approval from Chinese authorities, production is expected to begin in April.
Ascom has already exported some 10,000 payphones to China.
